messages:
tess: Quick thread to finalize the partner bench protocol and SKU copy for the marketplace. Partner wants one recommended SKU + a fallback. Need a strict measurement recipe.

omar: Proposal: primary power = external PDU (preferred). Fallback = IPMI (annotate & include resolution). Sample at 250ms, warmup 60s, steady window 90s. Normalize to seq=256 for the marketplace numbers. Record batches: 1,8,32,128 and quant modes fp16, q4_0.

li: Add a long-context check at seq=1024 to surface tail memory behavior. Telemetry should include: tokens/sec, tokens/sec/W, p50/p90 latency, kv_hit_rate, batch_histogram, power_source, power_resolution_ms, run_artifact_uri.

tess: Acceptance gate idea: best-config toks/sec/W >= 86% of our certified baseline => "Recommended"; 72-86% => "Supported (reduced perf)" with a note; <72% => do not list. Also require smoke eval (100 prompts) exact-match/logprob check.

omar: I'll own telemetry schema and a tiny translator that ingests PDU CSV or IPMI logs + runtime telemetry and emits our canonical JSON. Will open PR with schema + example parser. Example CLI for partners:
```
# collect run (example)
./rwd-collect --model redwood-7b --seq 256 --batch 32 --quant q4_0 \
  --pdu /tmp/pdu.csv --telemetry /tmp/tel.json --sample-ms 250 --out /tmp/run.json
```

li: I'll own kernel-change matrix and the microbench harness. Proposing three conservative knobs: 1) thread affinity tweak (low risk) 2) kv prefetch heuristic (medium) 3) async-copy fallback (medium-high). Each change gets a microbench and a regression test.

tess: Good. Deliverables: (1) telemetry schema + parser PR, (2) kernel patch matrix + microbench artifacts, (3) one-paragraph marketplace blurb + recommended SKU. Drafts due Tue EOD so we can freeze listing Thu.

ops-bot: Partner lab slot booked: partner-lab-2 rp-5319998 on 2026-04-12 08:00 UTC. Logs will be posted to CI when run starts.

partner-bot: Run rp-5319998 started. Uploading pdu.csv and tel.json on completion.

partner-bot: Run rp-5319998 finished. Quick numbers: seq256 batch32 q4_0 -> 438 toks/s, steady watts 207W => 2.116 toks/s/W. p50 13ms, p90 29ms. long-context seq1024 batch32 -> throughput dip ~12% vs seq256. Artifacts: s3://partners/5319998/tel.json and s3://partners/5319998/pdu.csv

omar: Thanks. I'll pull the artifacts, run the translator and compute tokens/sec/W normalized to seq256. If PDU missing we'll fallback to IPMI but we'll annotate power_resolution_ms.

li: Patch matrix draft incoming. I'll include expected deltas and a conservative recommended default for the marketplace (the config that hit highest toks/sec/W under the acceptance gate).

tess: One more rule: marketplace copy must use measured tokens/sec/W for the listed SKU and link to raw tel artifact. If partner used IPMI only, include explicit note "measured via IPMI (1s res)". Artifacts retained 180 days.

ops-bot: Automated perf-check scheduled for rp-5319998. Will post delta vs our baseline when finished.

partner-bot: Perf-check complete. rp-5319998 is 7% below baseline toks/sec/W => PASS for "Recommended" gate (threshold 12% allowed). Summary: https://ci.redwood/perf/rp-5319998/summary

tess: Great work. Omar/Li please open PRs and tag rp-5319998. We'll review artifacts Wed 10am PT and finalize the marketplace blurb. :rocket:
